speaker: Tendai Moreau
text: Good morning. Let's begin, we have a hard stop at ten.

speaker: Yara Chaudhry
text: Morning.

speaker: Wanjiru Nakashima
text: Morning, sorry, I'm on my phone, the laptop's doing an update.

speaker: Tendai Moreau
text: Fine. Ugo, please take us through the October close.

speaker: Yara Chaudhry
text: Sure. Revenue for the month came in at $6.6M, which is 1.5 percent ahead of forecast.

speaker: Tendai Moreau
text: And year to date?

speaker: Yara Chaudhry
text: Year to date we're at three hundred dollars.

speaker: Desmond Delacroix
text: That includes the one-off from Zephyrine Telecom, correct?

speaker: Yara Chaudhry
text: Yes. Excluding that, we're slightly behind.

speaker: Tendai Moreau
text: How far behind?

speaker: Yara Chaudhry
text: About eight point five percent.

speaker: Tendai Moreau
text: Gross margin?

speaker: Yara Chaudhry
text: Gross margin was 3.5 percent, down from last month because of the hosting true-up.

speaker: Wanjiru Nakashima
text: Can I jump in on bookings?

speaker: Tendai Moreau
text: Go ahead.

speaker: Wanjiru Nakashima
text: Q4 bookings so far are $1,650. Pipeline is healthy, about thirty two million dollars, but a lot of it is back-loaded into December.

speaker: Tendai Moreau
text: Hm. Churn?

speaker: Wanjiru Nakashima
text: Churn is up. Logo churn was 26% for the quarter. The biggest loss was van torra.

speaker: Desmond Delacroix
text: Sorry, who?

speaker: Wanjiru Nakashima
text: Vantorra Foods Group. The Fallowmere account.

speaker: Desmond Delacroix
text: Right, right.

speaker: Wanjiru Nakashima
text: And our second-largest customer told us informally they're putting their renewal out to tender.

speaker: Tendai Moreau
text: That's concerning. What's it worth?

speaker: Wanjiru Nakashima
text: Their ARR is six hundred ninety

speaker: Desmond Delacroix
text: ouch

speaker: Wanjiru Nakashima
text: two thousand dollars so, yeah, not small.

speaker: Tendai Moreau
text: Okay. Headcount?

speaker: Desmond Delacroix
text: We're at 1,105 FTEs against a plan of one thousand two hundred forty six.

speaker: Tendai Moreau
text: And the hiring freeze holds through year end.

speaker: Desmond Delacroix
text: Yes. Also, for the record, we wrote off $30 million from the old halvorsen freight partners dispute, and the auditors asked about the two thousand dollars sitting in suspense.

speaker: Tendai Moreau
text: Thank you, Mahlangu. One more thing, and this stays in this room. the board has approved an across-the-board price increase that takes effect at the start of next fiscal year.

speaker: Wanjiru Nakashima
text: Oh. Okay. That helps the margin story.

speaker: Yara Chaudhry
text: Should I model it at the low end or the high end?

speaker: Tendai Moreau
text: Both. Send me the file by June 24th.

speaker: Yara Chaudhry
text: Will do.

speaker: Tendai Moreau
text: Thank you all.

speaker: Wanjiru Nakashima
text: Thanks.
